common.referenceOnly: Reference only. Not for diagnosis, treatment planning, measurements, or implant workflows.

importPage.title: CBCTer
importPage.description: Inspect CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography) scans directly in the browser from local study folders. CBCTer parses supported exports locally, opens them as linked 2D slice views with a 3D volume overview, and separates individual teeth for export.
importPage.sampleDescription: Load the bundled CBCT volume to explore the viewer and tooth extraction without importing a folder.
importPage.remoteUrlPlaceholder: Link to a .cbct.zip (Hugging Face, GitHub raw, S3/R2…)

galileos.title: GALILEOS
galileos.description: Legacy GALILEOS study volumes stored as compressed slice files.
galileos.instruction: Select the study folder that contains <0>*_vol_0</0> and <1>*_vol_0_###</1>.

oneVolume.title: OneVolume CT
oneVolume.description: Native OneVolume volume stored in CT_0.vol.
oneVolume.instruction: Select the <0>CT_*</0> folder or the whole export folder; only CT_0.vol, CtStatus.csv and Constants1100.xml are read.

dicom.title: DICOM CT
dicom.description: Standard DICOM slice stacks, including disc exports whose slices have no file extension (e.g. Sirona Sidexis).
dicom.instruction: Select the <0>DICOM</0> folder or the series folder (e.g. <1>CT3</1>); the largest CT series is opened.

package.title: CBCTer scan package
package.description: Slim export made by this app: just the volume and its geometry, no vendor software or patient details. Opens fastest, including on phones.
package.instruction: Use Open ZIP file for a <0>.cbct.zip</0>, or pick the unzipped folder.

importPage.referenceNote: Any of these can also be zipped and opened with Open ZIP file. Vendor viewers, installers and <0>Series_01/</0> are ignored.
importPage.dropHint: Drop a .cbct.zip, a zipped vendor export or a NIfTI file anywhere on this page.

folderPicker.title: Open a scan folder
folderPicker.description: Choose a local export folder to load the scan into the viewer.
folderPicker.detail: The app builds the volume in-browser and opens linked axial, sagittal, coronal, and 3D views.
folderPicker.unsupportedHint: Folder selection needs a browser with directory upload support. Safari on iPhone requires iOS 18.4+.

progress.selectFolder: Select a supported CT folder to begin

viewerSidebar.windowHint: Contrast span. Smaller window = more contrast.
viewerSidebar.levelHint: Brightness bias. Higher level favors denser tissue.
viewerSidebar.thickSliceHint: This series has thick slices, so cross-plane views are coarse.
viewerSidebar.dragHint: Drag inside any 2D pane to scrub linked slices.
viewerSidebar.zoomHint: Wheel or pinch to zoom; when zoomed, scrubbing keeps the crosshair centered when possible.
viewerSidebar.orientationHint: Coronal and sagittal views are flipped so superior anatomy stays at the top.
viewerSidebar.volumeDownsampled: Downsampled from full volume to fit GPU texture limits.
viewerSidebar.planeHint: Colored planes in 3D match the current coronal, sagittal, and axial slices.

masks.empty: No masks yet. Create a threshold mask to start a client-side layer.

surfaces.empty: No surfaces yet. Generate one from the active mask.

measures.distance: Distance: point-to-point length in calibrated millimeters.
measures.roi: ROI: ellipse and polygon area, perimeter, and density stats.
measures.empty: No saved measurements yet. Use the ruler or angle tool in a slice view.

export.surfaces: Surfaces: STL and PLY mesh export path.
export.project: Project: local package of study state and generated objects.

teeth.title: Tooth extraction
teeth.subtitle: Review separated tooth labels and export meshes.

live.title: In-browser tooth segmentation
live.description: Runs the MONAI UNet fully client-side via onnxruntime-web over an ROI of the loaded volume. No server or upload.
live.needVolume: Load the sample CBCT (or a scan folder) in the viewer first, then come back to segment an ROI.
live.sizeHint: ROI ≈ {{dims}} voxels (padded to 144³ for the model).

gen.title: Generate library in-browser
gen.description: No prebuilt library for this scan? Run the tooth model right here to separate the arch into individual teeth — no server, no Python pipeline. Adjust the region to cover the teeth, then generate.
gen.unavailableNote: No prebuilt library was found for this set.
gen.needVolume: Load a CBCT scan in the viewer first, then come back to generate a library.
gen.separationHint: Lower splits touching teeth into more pieces; higher merges them.
gen.minToothVoxelsHint: Higher hides small fragments; lower keeps tiny candidates.
gen.noResults: No teeth were separated. Try enlarging the region or recentering it on the arch.

teeth.empty: No separated teeth in this set.
teeth.generateHint: Run the tooth separation pipeline against a DICOM folder to generate labels (see segment:* npm scripts).

anatomy.title: Full anatomy segmentation
anatomy.subtitle: Multi-class CBCT segmentation (DentalSegmentator nnU-Net).
anatomy.needVolume: Load a CBCT volume first to run full anatomy segmentation.
anatomy.description: Segment skull, mandible, upper/lower teeth, and the mandibular canal in one pass. Runs the nnU-Net model in your browser on the CPU (multi-threaded wasm).
anatomy.previewEmpty: Run segmentation to preview the labelled anatomy.
anatomy.perfNote: Full-volume 3D inference is heavy; the first run downloads the ~123 MB model. Multi-threaded CPU inference takes about a minute.

panoramic.title: Panoramic reconstruction
panoramic.subtitle: Unroll the dental arch into a flat panoramic (OPG-like) image.
panoramic.editHint: Click to add a point, drag to move, alt/right-click a point to remove. Auto-fit seeds the arch from bone; adjust freely.
panoramic.outputEmpty: Adjust the arch, then generate the panorama.

errors.failedToLoadSelectedScanFolder: Failed to load the selected scan folder.
errors.unsupportedFolderLayout: Unsupported folder layout. Select a CBCTer scan package, a GALILEOS study, a OneVolume export, or a DICOM folder (or a ZIP of one).

toolbar.measureHint: Tap points on a slice to measure

presets.title: Contrast presets
presets.adaptiveHint: Presets adapt to this scan's gray values (CBCT values are not true HU).

status.hover: Hover a slice to read values

measures.title: Measurements

report.disclaimer: Generated by CBCTer for reference and patient communication only. Not a diagnostic device; verify all findings and measurements in certified software before treatment.

items.wheel: Page slices · Ctrl/⌘ + wheel to zoom

package.title: Export slim package
package.description: Saves just this scan's volume as a .cbct.zip that opens directly in CBCTer on any device.
package.name: Package name
package.nameHint: Avoid patient names; the scan ID is used by default
package.preview: Include a small axial preview image
package.excluded: Left out: vendor viewers and installers, raw projection images, patient name/ID and original file headers. Measurements and the tooth chart are not included (use project export for those).
package.done: Saved ({{size}}). Open it later with Open ZIP file on the import screen.
package.bothDetail: One package: desktops open full resolution ({{full}}), phones open the half-resolution level ({{half}}) and never load the full data. Sizes before compression.
package.levelHint: This package has a full-resolution and a phone (half-resolution) level. Phones open the phone level by default.
package.caseIncludes: Includes masks, tooth IDs, review history, notes, measurements, surfaces and saved arch. Findings may contain patient information.
package.caseExcluded: The full native scan and optional analysis are saved together. Model weights and vendor software are excluded.

focus.pulpMissing: No pulp canal visible (it may be narrowed, filled or calcified).
focus.darkArea: Dark area, {{volume}} mm³, {{where}}, reaching the surface, {{density}}% of dentine density.

where.neck: at the neck of the tooth

focus.disclaimer: Automatic and unvalidated. Dark areas can be decay, resorption, a low-density filling or an artifact; only a dentist with an X-ray can tell.

pickFirst.right: Patient's right canal: click one end of the canal on a slice.
pickFirst.left: Patient's left canal: click one end of the canal on a slice.

pickSecond.right: Patient's right canal: click the other end on a slice.
pickSecond.left: Patient's left canal: click the other end on a slice.

canal.closest: Closest teeth to the canal (surface to canal wall)
canal.hint: The canal is a thin dark tube with a bright rim low in the back of the lower jaw; it is easiest to see on coronal slices. Tracing is approximate and assumes a 2.5 mm canal. Check it slice by slice; it is not suitable for implant or surgical planning.

addTooth.title: Add a missing tooth
addTooth.intro: If the model missed a tooth, pick its number, then click its crown on a slice. The outline is estimated from the scan; check it on a few slices.
addTooth.picking: Click the crown of tooth {{fdi}} on a slice.
addTooth.leaked: It reaches the edge of the search box, so it may have run into bone or a neighbour. Try “Tighter”.

picker.disclaimer: CBCT shows gums poorly, so the gumline is estimated from the bone. CBCT crowns are less exact than an intraoral scan, and teeth can move after the scan. Use the model as a reference for your orthodontist or lab, not as a direct replacement for a new scan.

review.title: Review teeth
review.mirrored: Left and right numbers look swapped: most teeth sit on the opposite side of the midline from their number. Check a tooth you know first.
review.splits: Cut in two by the model (the parts share a large surface):
review.overlap: {{a}} and {{b}} overlap: probably one tooth split in two. Select one, then merge the other into it.
review.acceptNextTitle: Accept this outline and go to the next unreviewed tooth
review.importHint: Choose a .cbcter.zip result for this scan. Imported proposals need review; your notes and corrections are kept.
review.modelHint: Requires installed ONNX weights and enough device memory. Full and pediatric models label anatomy; the universal model also proposes tooth identities. All proposals need review.
review.cloudHint: Experimental OralSeg and TIPs runner. You choose a scan to upload to your Colab runtime, then import its result here. A GPU runtime is required.
review.selectSource: Select a mask or label group
review.separateHint: Run anatomy segmentation in Study if no mask is available. Anatomy model weights are required. Separation uses a watershed and may need splits or merges.

compare.disclaimer: Compares tooth positions only. Small differences can come from scan noise; ask your orthodontist to confirm.
compare.caption: Change since the earlier scan, largest first
compare.shapeTitle: Largest surface difference once the tooth is lined up (wear, chips, fillings)
compare.reference: Used to line the scans up
compare.floor: mm; changes under {{mm}} mm or {{deg}}° are below what the scans can show. · marks the teeth used to line the scans up.

toothExport.savedGuessed_one: Saved {{count}} tooth; gumline guessed for {{guessed}} (no bone contact found).
toothExport.savedGuessed_other: Saved {{count}} teeth; gumline guessed for {{guessed}} (no bone contact found).

teethPanel.isoTooBig: Too many teeth for 3D on this device. Pick an arch or fewer teeth.
teethPanel.copyFallback: Copy the link from the box below.
teethPanel.canalMeasuring: Measuring distances to the lower teeth…
teethPanel.addNotFound: No tooth found there. Click on the crown of the tooth.
teethPanel.compareNoTeeth: The other scan has no tooth outlines. Open it on its own first and propose them.
teethPanel.compareAligning: Aligning the jaws and comparing teeth…
teethPanel.compareInput: Choose another scan package to compare
teethPanel.reportDarkArea: Dark area {{volume}} mm³ reaching the surface (automatic check)
teethPanel.reportNote: Unvalidated automatic finding — confirm with a dental X-ray.
teethPanel.mirrored: Left and right numbers look swapped compared with the scan orientation: most teeth sit on the opposite side from their number. Check a tooth you know (a filling, a gap) before trusting them.
teethPanel.splits_one: One tooth looks cut in two by the model (the parts share a large surface):
teethPanel.splits_other: {{count}} teeth look cut in two by the model (the parts share a large surface):
teethPanel.splitsSaved: Saved on this device and carried in share links.
teethPanel.tapHint: Tap a tooth or a slice
teethPanel.showHint: “Only selected” shows those teeth alone in the slices and builds a full-resolution 3D view of them.
teethPanel.iosImportSelected_one: Import STL / PLY / OBJ and align to {{count}} selected teeth
teethPanel.iosImportSelected_other: Import STL / PLY / OBJ and align to {{count}} selected teeth
teethPanel.iosImportAll: Import STL / PLY / OBJ and align to all teeth
teethPanel.iosFit: {{name}}: aligned with RMS {{rms}} mm; {{inliers}}% of its points sit on the CBCT. CBCT crowns are {{mean}} mm from it on average (95% within {{p95}} mm).
teethPanel.iosPoor: The fit looks poor: check that the scan covers the selected teeth and the same jaw.
teethPanel.iosShow: Show its outline on the slices (cyan)
teethPanel.iosUse: Add its crowns to the STL export
teethPanel.iosHint: An intraoral scan from a dentist or orthodontist is about five times more exact on the crowns than CBCT. Aligning it to the CBCT lets the exported model use scanned crowns on CBCT roots. Select the teeth the scan covers first.
teethPanel.checkAll: Look for dark areas in every tooth
teethPanel.darkArea: Dark area {{volume}} mm³ {{where}}, reaching the surface.
teethPanel.allClear: No compact dark areas found; every tooth shows a pulp canal.
teethPanel.checkHint: Flags compact dark areas reaching a tooth surface (possible decay, resorption or a low-density filling) and teeth with no visible pulp canal. Automatic and unvalidated; a dentist needs an X-ray to tell.
teethPanel.noTeeth: This scan has no tooth outlines yet. Add teeth one by one below, or open the full editor to propose them with a model.
teethPanel.contrastHint: Presets: keys 1–6. Drag on a slice with the Contrast tool (W).
teethPanel.shareHint: Anyone with the link can open this scan. The link opens the file where it is hosted. Scan names can contain the scan date.
teethPanel.shareHintTooth: Anyone with the link can open this scan. The link opens the file where it is hosted and selects {{name}}. Scan names can contain the scan date.
teethPanel.shareLocal: This scan is only on this device. To send it, share the .cbct.zip file itself; the recipient drops it on the CBCTer start page. For a link that opens straight into this view, host the file where other websites may read it (Hugging Face, GitHub raw files under 100 MB, or an S3/R2 bucket with CORS) and open it once from that link. Google Drive and Dropbox links can't be opened by other sites.

streaming.advanced: Load full volume for advanced tools
streaming.advancedHint: Segmentation, panoramic views and full-volume processing are available after loading the full volume.
streaming.exportHint: Preserves the complete native grid when available and opens a preview before loading full-resolution regions. Older packages retain their existing processed values.
